sloka: विदर्शिता यदा देवी कुब्जया पापया भृशम् ।तदा शेते स्म सा भूमौ दिग्धविद्धेव किन्नरी ॥२-१०-१॥
transliteration: vidarśitā yadā devī kubjayā pāpayā bhṛśam ।tadā śete sma sā bhūmau digdhaviddheva kinnarī ॥2-10-1॥

translations.english: Perversely advised by the extremely sinful hunchback the queen (Kaikeyi) lay down on the ground like a kinnari struck as though by a poisonous arrow.
